title: DOM radiosity
blurb: Live HTML buttons, dark movable pillars and a glowing text input uploaded with drawElementImageToTexture(), turned into a Jump-Flood distance field and 2D Radiance Cascades global illumination on the GPU.
question: Can a WebGPU compute pipeline read a live HTML texture from drawElementImageToTexture(), build a Jump-Flood distance field and 2D Radiance Cascades global illumination on the GPU, and let live inputs, buttons and typed glyphs emit coloured light and cast soft shadows?
